description: This Java source file defines the 'CancelSubscription' command class used within the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically for cancelling subscriptions to search results in the thing search system. It includes methods for creating instances, JSON serialization/deserialization, and metadata about the command.

classes.name: CancelSubscription
classes.description: Represents a command to cancel a specific subscription within the Ditto thing search system. Contains methods for creation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and overrides for equality, hash code, and string representation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new CancelSubscription command instance with specified subscription ID and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a CancelSubscription instance from a JsonObject and headers.

methods.name: getSubscriptionId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the subscription to be canceled.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the subscription ID to the JSON payload for serialization.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the command category, which is QUERY for this command.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of CancelSubscription with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on subscription ID and superclass properties.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Calculates hash code including subscription ID.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object, including class name, superclass info, and subscription ID.
